messages:
Maya: Hey @eng-runtime — marketing needs a quick verification for the launch claim: 'Redwood lowers per-token inference cost by up to 3x vs unmanaged open-source serving' before we push the blog + social. Can the runtime team run a validation lightwalk and confirm methodology + artifact handoff? We need model variants, seq length buckets, quantized vs fp16, warmup profile. Target: publish by Friday. :pray:

Priya: Hey Maya — we can do a lightweight pass. Need exact models and payloads + what '3x' refers to (median? avg?). Also what's the runtime baseline? self-hosted HF or specific cloud endpoint? cc Jared.

Jared: Timeline looks OK. We can run a 4-cohort sweep (short/medium/long/stream). What we'll need from you: 1) sample JSONL, 2) traffic mix, 3) quantization flags to test, 4) seed/RNG notes, 5) which percentiles to report (p50/p90/p95). Drop artifacts to the handoff folder or share a link.

Maya: Uploaded sample pack here: https://drive.redwood/samples/launch_lightwalk_v1.jsonl — includes ~2k samples split by length. Baseline for 'unmanaged' is 'vanilla HF load with batch=1 on A100 fp16'. Does that baseline match your expectations?

Priya: Good pack. We'll run both coldstart and warm steady-state. For coldstart we need the exact container/ENV. If marketing can't provide, we'll document our env: kernel, PyTorch, transformers, and runtime flags. We will report per-token ms and a cost estimate using current cloud prices. OK?

Sam: Quick note — marketing needs aggregated claim with a 95% CI and a one-line caveat about sample selection. Also highlight any failure modes (long-tail quantization regressions).

Jared: Plan: run smoke sweep tomorrow morning, then a more thorough sweep if anything looks marginal. Can you confirm the folder contains payloads + a README with stratification? Also include a mapping to customer persona (search/summarize/chat).

Maya: Added README.md with stratification + persona tags, and a short 'publish draft' doc in the folder. Thanks! :thumbsup:

bench-bot: job=start sweep-1738284680 | queue: eng-runtime | user: jared | expected duration: 3h

Priya: Marketing — one decision needed: what do you want as the acceptance criteria for the 3x headline? e.g., >=2.8x across short+medium p90, or >=3.0x median only? If we miss, we'll provide qualified language.

Maya: Prefer >=3.0x median across short+medium. If not met, fallback to 'up to 3x' with explicit notes and a link to raw artifacts. Please keep quantized results separated.

Jared: Copy. We'll capture raw logs, condensed CSVs per cohort, and a stripped artifact package you can publish. We'll ping this thread with results and the CSV.

Priya: FYI if quantized numbers are noisy we may ask marketing to accept a narrower warmup policy for the publishable claim. Will flag early if that looks likely.

Sam: Once the sweep is done, please +1 a 15-min sync so we can finalize the exact claim language and the one-line caveat.

Maya: Sounds good — standing by.

Jared: quick paste of the smoke command we'll run so marketing knows what we measured:
```
./run_sweep.sh --samples launch_lightwalk_v1.jsonl --batch 1 --warmup 200 --quantize none,ptq --report p50,p90,p95 --out artifacts/sweep-1738284680
```

Jared: will post artifacts + summary CSV here when done. Thanks everyone!
